title: The Missing Critical Minerals Investment
gist: Western critical-minerals policy over-indexes on refining and near-production mines; because a mine takes ~20 years, the G-7 must finance early-stage projects stuck in the junior-miner 'valley of death', where China is often the only capital source. Proposes G-7-linked flow-through share tax credits, tax reform for pension/endowment investors, and a pooled feasibility-study fund taking equity/royalties.
